items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Mu kiseera kye yali akola mu gavumenti, abantu baali beeyongedde okukozesa abo abaali mu kibiina kya ADF mu bukiikakkono.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baali bamanyi obulumbaganyi bw'abo abaali mu kiseera kino nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku b'amagye baali bafuna obulumbaganyi era abo abali ku ludda oluvuganya gavumenti baali beegatta ku kubanga baali basobola okukola obutujju.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abakulu mu kitongole ky'eby'okwerinda baakola ku nsonga ez'okuba abo abaali b'omu ku ludda oluvuganya gavumenti okukuba nti baali bawagira.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Aba ADF abalala baali beegatta gavumenti okukola abantu ne bafuna ssente.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Ebikwata ku bbomu ezaabwatukira mu Kampala nga Jjulaayi 11 zaali zikwata ku bikwata ku ADF ne mu Somalia aba Al-Shabaab.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abantu bangi abalala abalina okuba ab'omu ku mikutu gy'obulamu, abo abasimbyewo ku ADF baali basobola okukola mu kifo ky'abavubuka.
